component.name: AppImage Manager
component.summary: Lightweight utility to install and manage AppImages

description.p: AppImage Manager is a native tool designed for the KDE Plasma desktop to make handling AppImage files easier. It integrates directly into the Dolphin file manager and provides a centralized dashboard to view everything you have installed.

ul.li: Open an AppImage with AppImage Manager from Dolphin to install it.
Drag-and-drop support into a centralized dashboard.
Extracts rich metadata, icons, and descriptions directly from the AppImages.
Source-agnostic architecture supporting custom JSON repository sources in the Discover settings.
Clean uninstallation by automatically scanning for leftover cache and configuration files.
Built-in update system using zsync for efficient delta-patching.
Background download monitoring to notify you when new AppImages are downloaded.

screenshot.caption: Discover page for browsing and installing new AppImages
Drag-and-drop installation from the file manager

ul.li: Discover opens in a fraction of a second instead of half a minute or more.
Discover looks and works like Installed: the same resizable list, and details with About and a Details section listing the category, license, catalogs and links.

description.p: Safer apps, smaller updates and a tray that fits Plasma.

ul.li: Run an app, or all of them, in a sandbox that only sees its own folder and the folders you allow.
Release notes for apps released on GitHub, Codeberg, Forgejo or Gitea.
Undo an update: the previous version is kept and can be restored.
Built-in delta updates: only the changed parts of an app are downloaded.
A system tray widget with an overview of all AppImages and their update state.
Every app shows where it stands: up to date, update available, no update source or check failed.
Keep an app's settings in the Applications folder; signatures shown and checked correctly.
Installing an app you already have offers to replace it or keep both.

description.p: A cleaner, quieter interface with Installed and Discover tabs, and more ways to update.

ul.li: Update sources: GitHub, Codeberg, Forgejo and Gitea repositories, a zsync file or a direct download link, detected from what you paste.
Environment variables per app, used from AppImage Manager and from the app menu.
Discover is opt-in for new installs, so no catalogs are downloaded until you turn it on.
Downloads that turn out to be web pages never replace an installed app.
Fixes for app icons, scrolling, update checks on large libraries, catalog reordering and more.

description.p: Bug fixes: corrected QSortFilterProxyModel filter invalidation (endFilterChange → invalidateFilter), fixed QML module import path for out-of-tree builds, and removed invalid stock icon tag from AppStream metadata.

Modular discover sources. Dynamic sources configuration from Settings. Source-agnostic universal JSON feed support. Smooth drag-to-reorder AppImage source prioritization. Preferred installation method (AM script vs. direct download) dynamically determined by source order. Added a first-time user onboarding wizard with Applications folder setup and feature overview.

KirigamiAddons FormCard settings layout. KConfig XT settings backend. Process-wide icon store shared across engine instances. Dashboard delegate replaced with Controls.ItemDelegate for uniform selection highlight. Removed batch selection mode. Fixed persistent "Loading N…" label caused by synchronous cache hits racing against pendingLoads assignment. Removed StorageDialog. Drag icon visual improved in manage window.

Settings redesigned with card-based layout. New About dialog with contributor list and library versions. Accent border toggle. Sandbox detection for Flatpak/Snap environments. Nine new translations (cs, ja, pl, pt_BR, ru, sk, tr, uk, zh_CN). Atomic update swap with crash recovery. Concurrent icon rendering with split read/write locks. Background update timer now correctly skips when frequency is set to Never.
Async file hashing for update checks. HTTP fallback when zsync2 is absent. Localized AppImage descriptions. Releases atom feed failover.
AppImage update system via zsync delta-patching. Code cleanup and stability improvements.
